full_judgment: co-sharers are owners of dag Nos.7132,7134,7138,7137 and 7136 and they became recorded tenant in the khatians Dag No.7133 belonged to defendant No.1 which is in khatian Nos.473/475. Western portion of dag No.7134 was in possession of the defendant and to avoid yearly bamboo fence, they erected a pucca wall. The plaintiffs right of casement in question is on dag No.7112. The plaintiff or his predecessors were never in use of pathway. The plaintiffs instituted Miscellaneous Case Nos.7 and 8 of 1992 but those were dismissed.
